'''Hammer''' can refer to the following:

* ''[[Crossroads of Twilight/Chapter 5|The Forging of a Hammer]]'' - the fifth chapter of ''[[Crossroads of Twilight]]''.

==Items==
* ''[[Mah'alleinir]]'' - the [[Power-wrought]] warhammer created by [[Perrin Aybara]].
* The hammer given to Perrin by [[Dermid Ajala]].

==Other==
* [[Perrin Aybara#The Axe and the Hammer|The Axe and the Hammer]] - the moral quandary faced by Perrin Aybara.
* [[Hammer (horse)|Hammer]] - a horse owned by [[Tervail Dura]].
